Taped 12/9/05; Bagram, Afghanistan; Air Base
“Holiday with the Troops” – 12/19/05; featured an opening in-ring segment where Vince McMahon praised the troops for their efforts and said they were being largely ignored by the media in the States; he then introduced Lilian Garcia who sang “The Star Spangled Banner”; included footage of the WWE superstars visiting Ramstein Air Force Base and Landstuhl Regional Medical Center on their way to Afghanistan; featured a video package on the high number of land mines positioned in the area; included footage of WWE World Champion John Cena and WWE Women’s Champion Trish Stratus holding a press conference for Afghan TV; featured footage of MSNBC’s Rita Cosby documenting the WWE’s tour, with comments from Rita, JBL, Triple H, and Vince McMahon; Cosby was later shown in attendance of the show; included video montages of the tour set to “You and Me” by Lifehouse and “Right Here Waiting” by Staind; featured a commercial for the following week’s Raw where Kurt Angle would make a major announcement; included a video package on some of the soldiers killed in the line of duty; featured a closing video package set to Scott Stapp’s “You Set Me Free”:
WWE Raw Tag Team Champion the Big Show pinned Carlito Caribbean Cool with the chokeslam at 1:09
Mick Foley pinned John Bradshaw Layfield in a no holds barred match with the Mr. Socko Mandible Claw at 1:58 after a double arm DDT; the match came about after JBL, dressed as Santa Claus, was interviewed in the ring by Jonathan Coachman, with JBL saying he was going to cancel all the holidays; moments later, Foley, also dressed as Santa, came out and said he wanted a no holds barred match against the other Santa; during the contest, both of their costumes were removed
Gene Snitsky pinned Shelton Benjamin at 1:52 with a boot to the face after Benjamin hit his head on an exposed top turnbuckle
WWE World Champion John Cena pinned Chris Masters in a non-title match at 4:53 with the FU
WWE IC Champion Ric Flair defeated Jonathan Coachman via submission with the figure-4 at 2:01
Candice Michelle & Maria defeated WWE Women’s Champion Trish Stratus & Ashley when Candice pinned Ashley with a roll up and grabbing the clothes for leverage at 4:16
Shawn Michaels pinned Triple H in a bootcamp match at 13:35 with the superkick after a catapult sent Triple H face-first into the corner; prior to the bout, Jerry Lawler & Joey Styles mentioned that one of the soldiers on hand, Chris Polumbo, is the brother of former WWE wrestler Chuck Polumbo and was a recipient of the silver star

12/26/05; Bridgeport, CT; Harbor Yard Arena
Raw – featured an opening segment in which Vince McMahon announced that the search for a new Raw GM would continue later in the night and that all six participants in the Elimination Chamber would compete in “Beat the Clock” matches, with the wrestler with the quickest win earning the opportunity to enter the chamber last; McMahon then said he would review the Bret Hart DVD later in the broadcast; included The Cutting Edge with Edge & Lita in which a Ric Flair impersonator (Matt Striker) appeared on the big screen, with Edge saying Flair stole everything – from the chops to the nickname to the Wooo; moments later, the real Flair came out and cleared the ring of both Edge and Lita; later in the show, Vince said Flair would defend the IC title against Edge at New Year’s Revolution; featured a sit-down backstage promo by Kurt Angle in which he said he was proud to have not gone on the tour of Afghanistan, noting the U.S. troops shouldn’t be praised so much for simply doing their job and that no one forced them to join the military; Angle then said they all made him sick and then stormed off; included Torrie Wilson applying for the Raw GM position; featured Mickie James dressing up the women’s locker room for Trish Stratus as a Christmas present and kissing Trish underneath the mistletoe, with Trish then walking out of the locker room; included the contract signing between Triple H and WWE Raw Tag Team Champion the Big Show for their match at New Year’s Revolution, overseen by Jonathan Coachman, during which the two men shared words before Triple H stabbed Show in the face with the pen and smashed Show’s right hand with the sledgehammer before he signed the contract and left ringside; featured a video on Stacy Keibler training for “Dancing with the Stars 2”; included a backstage promo by Carlito Caribbean Cool in which he did a Christmas rhyme about winning the world title, then spat an apple at the camera; featured a closing segment in which Vince McMahon showed a brief clip from the Bret Hart DVD of Bret saying he wouldn’t change anything he did; moments later, Shawn Michaels came out, with the crowd chanting “We Want Bret”, said he would do it all over again and then told Vince to move on and not to let it be a constant topic of conversation; Vince then said that Bruno Sammartino, Pedro Morales, Superstar Billy Graham, and Hulk Hogan all “moved on” but McMahon remained constant, and then asked if Shawn wanted to join that list; McMahon said his New Year’s resolution was not to take crap from Michaels or anyone else and that, while he did screw Bret Hart, he could also screw Micheals:
Beat the Clock Match: Shawn Michaels pinned Gene Snitsky with the superkick at 5:56
Beat the Clock Match: Chris Masters fought Chavo Guerrero Jr. to a no contest at around 6:20 when, after Masters realized he would not beat Michaels’ time, he released the full nelson and cut an in-ring promo saying that the clock was off but he would still win the WWE World Title at “New Year’s Resolution”; moments later, Chavo cleared Masters from the ring
Beat the Clock Match: Daivari defeated Kurt Angle via count-out at 1:16 when Angle chased referee Mike Chioda into the crowd when Chioda refused to count Angle’s cover as Daivari laid down for his opponent, with Chioda sliding back into the ring to administer the 10-count
Beat the Clock Match: WWE World Champion John Cena defeated Shelton Benjamin in a non-title match at 7:16 via submission with the STFU after hitting the FU; after the bout, Cena fought off an interfering Daivari before he and Kurt Angle were pulled apart by officials; after the commercial break, Benjamin was shown talking to someone on the phone, with the other person on the line saying they would appear the following week; moments later, as Matt Striker spoke to Vince McMahon about applying for the Raw GM position, Vince said Cena would face Angle next week in a First Blood match
Beat the Clock Match: Carlito Caribbean Cool pinned Victoria (w/ Torrie Wilson & Candice Michelle) with the Roll of the Dice at 2:36; after the bout, Carlito spat an apple in Victoria’s face
Beat the Clock Match: WWE Raw Tag Team Champion Kane defeated the Heart Breakers in a handicap match at the 27-second mark by pinning both following a double chokeslam; because Kane earned the quickest win of all the Elimination Chamber participants, he won the right to enter the match last
